_note: Original motivational lines written for B.A.B. Keep every line original.
lines: Show up first. The results catch up later.
A short walk still counts. Go take it.
You do not need a perfect day. You need today.
Small numbers, every day, turn into big ones.
The hardest rep is putting your shoes on.
Yesterday is logged. Today is still blank. Fill it.
Strong is built on ordinary Tuesdays.
Slow progress is still progress. Keep the streak alive.
Move a little more than you did last week. That is the whole plan.
Your future self is watching. Give them something good.
Ten minutes beats zero minutes every single time.
Effort today, energy tomorrow.
Do the boring basics well. That is the secret.
Missed a day? Fine. Do not miss two.
Water, walk, workout. Start with whichever is easiest.
Count the steps, not the excuses.
Sweat now, sleep well tonight.
You are one session away from a better mood.
Earn the rest day. Then actually rest.
Discipline is just remembering what you want.
Keep the promise you made to yourself this morning.
Climb the stairs. Your legs will thank you later.
Eat like you are training, because you are.
Consistency is louder than intensity.
Stack today on top of yesterday.
Tired is normal. Quitting is optional.
Light weight, good form, every day. That is how it starts.
Breathe in, brace, go.
Progress hides in the notes you log. Keep logging.
Get outside. The sky is free.
Beat your own yesterday, nobody else's.
One more set of stairs, one more lap, one more step.
Rest is part of training, not a break from it.
Today is a good day to be a little stronger.
Protein, sleep, steps. Repeat.
A plan on paper is nice. A plan in motion is better.
Your body keeps the score of every walk.
Start before you feel ready.
Be a beast in small ways, every day.
Finish what you started this week.
